reason: Adds ttft_sample_count to ops_metrics_hourly and ops_metrics_daily so TTFT aggregates are weighted by streaming rows instead of all successful requests.
risk: The migration adds NOT NULL columns with DEFAULT 0 to existing ops metrics tables, which can briefly take table locks while PostgreSQL updates metadata and validates the default.
mitigation: The change is additive and idempotent, uses a 5s lock_timeout, and leaves existing rows with a safe zero count until the normal ops metrics re-aggregation repopulates them.
